scenes.narration: You are not lazy. If you were lazy, you would not feel guilty about putting things off. The fact that you care is proof that something else is going on.
Procrastination is not a time management problem. It is an emotion regulation problem. Your brain is not avoiding the work. It is avoiding the bad feeling the work produces.

When you think about a hard task, your amygdala fires up. It reads the task as a threat, floods you with mild stress, and your brain reaches for anything that makes that feeling stop. Usually that thing is your phone.
Do that for one week and the shame loop breaks. You were never broken. You were just managing feelings instead of minutes.
